definition: Last adjusted close / first adjusted close in the window - 1. Adjusted close assumes dividends are reinvested.
(End / Start) ^ (1 / years) - 1, where years = calendar days / 365.25.
Sample standard deviation of daily returns x sqrt(252).
consistency: Same as /api/portfolio. Power BI: STDEV.S(fact_daily[daily_return]) * SQRT(252).

definition: (CAGR - risk-free rate) / Annualized Volatility. Risk-free rate is user-set (default 2%).
Largest fall from a running peak inside the selected window, measured on daily closes.
consistency: Same as /api/calculate. Power BI fact_daily[drawdown_from_peak] measures from the all-time high instead; the two agree when the window starts at a high.

definition: First date after the max drawdown trough when value regained the prior peak. Blank if not yet recovered.
CAGR after restating the end value in start-date dollars with CPI-U (FRED CPIAUCSL), using the latest CPI reading on or before each date.
consistency: Same inflation rule as /api/calculate with inflation adjustment on.

definition: Year-end value / prior year-end value - 1. First and last years are partial when the window does not cover the full year.
Volatility of the trailing 252 trading days, sampled at each month end.
Two-asset portfolio reset to target weights on the first trading day of each quarter or year (or never). No taxes or fees.
consistency: Same path logic as /api/portfolio in a tax-advantaged account; checked in powerbi_export/reconciliation.csv.

definition: S&P 500 price-index CAGR for every monthly start date with N full years after it. Price only: excludes dividends.
Bootstrap of historical daily returns in 21-day months, compounded with monthly contributions; p10 to p90 of simulated paths.
